assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded as I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring is ordered
The service is intended to evaluate for potential arrhythmias
The service addresses the clinical indication for correlating palpitations and dyspnea with rhythm disturbances
